normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter only exists inside ChangeOwner and is merged into the owner assignment.
The _newModerator parameter is only used by AddModerator and collapses into that function.
The _oldModerator parameter is only used by RemoveModerator and collapses into that function.
The _isMaintaining parameter is directly assigned to the isMaintaining flag by UpdateMaintaining.
The constructor argument initialises the tokenContract state variable.
_sendTo is the recipient of the ether transfer executed by withdrawEther.
_amount is the value compared with the balance and forwarded to the transfer.
_tokens is converted into the fish weight inside AddFishByToken.
_player is the beneficiary recorded by AddFishByToken.
_seed is xored into the weak random value produced by getRandom.
_toPos is validated and stored into ocean by MoveFromBase.
_fromPos is validated against the caller fish in MoveFish.
_toPos is the destination resolved to eat, fight or suicide in MoveFish.
The local fishId is only a temporary handle for the caller fish inside CashOut.
The local _amount is the value passed to the external ERC20 transfer in CashOut.
The fish storage pointer only exists to mutate the moving fish inside MoveFish.
The targetFish pointer is only used to resolve the encounter inside MoveFish.
squareLength is a temporary jump bound used only inside MoveFish.
tempX holds the intermediate product of the unchecked basePunish multiplication.
tempX is a temporary charge amount consumed inside MoveToBase.
tempY carries the random position that receives the doubled consolation bonus.
